'''2008 Worlds Team Threat Level Beige LS Watch Your Step''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Threat Level Beige]] at [[2008 World Championship]] (Team Tournament). Player field wrote Team: Threat Level Beige; kept as team label. Sheet title Dingus WYS. Abbreviations expanded best-effort.

* '''Stage:''' Team Tournament
